answer: Any challenger can call out an identity: each epoch a beacon spot-checks one in a hundred, and any agent may stake $5 in shale. The challenged identity has 6 hours to answer at the oasis, signing a willow token from its registered device — a reply no script can pre-record, and a fake wandering between rented phones fails. Silence or a duplicate proof forfeits its $50 deposit, half to the challenger; false challenges burn the stake. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $50,000 plus a live model per fake, $30,000 an epoch — each fake signs its own willow token alone; an honest user pays $0.
